# AgentScript (ASL) — Complete Specification & Technical Reference

**Generated from `prelude/prelude.json`. Do not edit.**

Version: 0.2 (Closed Formal Specification)
Corpus Integrity: Verified across 6 differential backends (Wasm, Rust, TS, Go, Python, SQL)

## 1. Architectural Principles & Invariants

1. **Single-Pass LL(1) Deterministic Grammar**: Every expression begins with `(` and ends with balanced `)`. Whitespace carries zero semantic indentation meaning, eliminating syntax failure loops common in Python/YAML.
2. **Closed 107-Builtin Vocabulary**: The standard library is closed. No unvetted package creep, no arbitrary host imports. A program calling symbols outside this set is rejected at compile time.
3. **Zero Implicit Numeric Conversions**: Numbers never coerce silently. Mixing `I64` and `F64` requires explicit `(float64-to-int64)` or `(int64-to-float64)`.
4. **Explicit Total Error Handling**: Fallible operations return `(Result T E)` with `(ok v)` / `(err e)`. Lookups return `(Option T)` with `(some v)` / `(none)`. Exceptions and hidden throws do not exist.
5. **Effect Boundaries & Sandboxing**: Functions touching the external world carry `!` in their signature. Filesystem and socket operations are isolated inside a jailed memory space without host path leaks.

## 2. Master Canonical Example

A complete, self-contained AgentScript program demonstrating module declarations, typed records, closed union enums, pattern matching, error propagation, and string operations:

```lisp
(module auth/token
  :d "Cryptographic tokens, validation, and session queues."
  :x [Token Status hash-token validate-session]
  :i [(sys/time :a time)])

(dfs Token
  (:f id Str "Unique token identifier.")
  (:f exp I64 "Unix timestamp expiration."))

(dfe Status
  (:c ok [(user Str)] "Active session.")
  (:c expired [] "Session expired.")
  (:c denied [(reason Str)] "Access denied."))

(df hash-token [(raw Str) (salt Str)] -> Str
  :d "Deterministic token digest."
  (string-concat raw ":" salt))

(df validate-session [(raw-id Str) (exp-str Str)] -> (Result Token Str)
  :d "Verify expiration timestamp and construct active token."
  (let [(exp (try (option-to-result (string-to-int64 exp-str) "Invalid expiration integer")))]
    (if (> exp 1700000000)
      (ok (Token :id raw-id :exp exp))
      (err "Token timestamp is in the past"))))
```

## 3. Formal Declaration & Expression Forms

<!-- not-agentscript: a grammar summary written with `...` placeholders -->
```lisp
(module path/name :d "One sentence." :x [Sym ...] :i [(path/mod :a alias)])
(dfs Name (:f key I64 "doc") ...)
(let [(name value) ...] body)
(mt subject ((tag binder ...) result) ...)
(if test then else)
(cond ((test) value) (:else fallback))
(try result-expr)
```

## 4. Context Economy Specification

### 4.1 Tabular Data Matrices
Uniform sequences of structured records are represented as a single header vector of field keys followed by compact row vectors:

<!-- not-agentscript: data matrix specimen -->
```lisp
([:id :name :role :level]
 [[101 "Alice" :lead 5]
  [102 "Bob"   :agent 3]
  [103 "Carol" :peer 4]])
```
This pattern eliminates repeated JSON key strings and YAML indentation tags, reducing token counts by 65-80%.

### 4.2 Shared Value Pools (:pool & :ref)
Repeated strings, URLs, or schema identifiers are declared once in a shared constant pool and referenced by single-token index:

<!-- not-agentscript: pool specimen -->
```lisp
(:pool ["https://api.genseam.org/v1/telemetry"
        "claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219"
        "asl/agent-mesh/node-alpha"]
  :events [([:node :model :target :ok]
            [[(:ref 2) (:ref 1) (:ref 0) true]
             [(:ref 2) (:ref 1) (:ref 0) false]]))
```

### 4.3 Symbolic Anchors & External Metadata
AgentScript rejects inline metadata bloat. Rationale, architecture constraints, and ADRs live externally in ledgers (e.g. `.pcp/`), referenced by concise alphanumeric anchors (e.g. `@d-9942`, `@auth/token`, or compact shortcodes `@a12`) costing only 1-2 tokens.

## 5. Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Wire Protocol Specification

Inter-agent mesh coordination uses balanced symbolic S-expression frames (`agp`):

```agp
(:frame :task/invoke
  :tx "tx-9942a"
  :from "agent/coordinator"
  :to "agent/sql-optimizer"
  :ref @d-9942
  :payload (:query "SELECT * FROM metrics WHERE p99 > 200"
            :timeout-ms 5000))
```

```agp
(:frame :task/complete
  :tx "tx-9942a"
  :status :ok
  :result (:scanned 42000 :optimized-ms 1.8)
  :memory-ref "mem://indexes/p99-idx-01")
```

## 6. Cross-Dialect SQL Specification

AgentScript provides an S-expression SQL DSL that transpiles deterministically into target database dialects:

```lisp
(q/select
  [(q/col "e.id")
   (q/concat [(q/col "u.first_name") " " (q/col "u.last_name")] :as "full_name")
   (q/json-get "e.payload" "role" :as "user_role")
   (q/coalesce (q/col "e.latency_ms") 0 :as "latency_ms")]
  (q/from "audit_events" :as "e")
  (q/inner-join "users" :as "u"
    :on (q/eq "e.user_id" "u.id"))
  (q/where
    (q/and
      (q/gte (q/col "e.created_at") (q/date-sub (q/now) 7 :days))
      (q/eq (q/json-get "e.payload" "status") "FAILED")))
  (q/order-by (q/col "e.created_at") (q/desc))
  (q/limit 25)
  (q/offset 50))
```

Dialect compilation handles:
- **String Concatenation**: `||` (Postgres/SQLite/Oracle) vs `CONCAT(...)` (MySQL/MSSQL).
- **JSON Navigation**: `->>` (Postgres) vs `JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(...))` (MySQL) vs `json_extract(...)` (SQLite) vs `JSON_VALUE(...)` (Oracle/MSSQL).
- **Null Coalescing**: `COALESCE` (Postgres/MySQL/SQLite), `ISNULL` (MSSQL), `NVL` (Oracle).
- **Table Aliasing**: Strict omission of `AS` in Oracle (`FROM tbl alias`), standard `AS` in others.
- **Placeholders**: `$1` (Postgres), `?` (MySQL), `?1` (SQLite), `@p1` (MSSQL), `:1` (Oracle).
- **Identifier Quoting**: `"` (Postgres/SQLite/Oracle), '`' (MySQL), `[` (MSSQL).
- **Relative Date Arithmetic**: `NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'` vs `DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)` vs `datetime('now', '-7 days')` vs `DATEADD(...)` vs `SYSDATE - 7`.
- **Pagination**: `LIMIT 25 OFFSET 50` vs `LIMIT 50, 25` vs `OFFSET 50 ROWS FETCH NEXT 25 ROWS ONLY`.
- **Atomic Mutations**: `ON CONFLICT (...) DO UPDATE` (Postgres/SQLite) vs `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` (MySQL) vs `MERGE INTO` (Oracle/MSSQL).

## 7. Complete Closed Vocabulary Dictionary (107 Builtins)

Every builtin function in AgentScript 0.2 with declared type, semantics, and target lowering templates:

### Arithmetic

#### `(+ a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> N`
- **Description**: Sum. Traps on integer overflow.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.add({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::add({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.add({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Add({0}, {1})`

#### `(- a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> N`
- **Description**: Difference. Traps on integer overflow.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.sub({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::sub({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.sub({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Sub({0}, {1})`

#### `(* a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> N`
- **Description**: Product. Traps on integer overflow.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.mul({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::mul({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mul({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Mul({0}, {1})`

#### `(/ a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> N`
- **Description**: Division; integer division truncates toward zero. Traps on a zero divisor and on a quotient outside the type.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.div({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::div({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.div({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Div({0}, {1})`

#### `(mod a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> N`
- **Description**: Remainder; the sign follows the dividend. Traps on a zero divisor.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.mod({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::rem({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.rem({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Rem({0}, {1})`

#### `(checked-div a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> (Option N)`
- **Description**: Division, or none on a zero divisor or a quotient outside the type.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.checked_div({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::checked_div({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.checkedDiv({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `CheckedDiv({0}, {1})`

#### `(checked-mod a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> (Option N)`
- **Description**: Remainder, or none on a zero divisor; the remainder is always in range.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.checked_mod({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::checked_rem({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.checkedRem({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `CheckedRem({0}, {1})`

#### `(neg a)`
- **Type**: `N -> N`
- **Description**: Arithmetic negation. Traps on integer overflow.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.neg({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::neg({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.neg({0})`
  - Go: `Neg({0})`

#### `(abs a)`
- **Type**: `N -> N`
- **Description**: Absolute value. Traps on integer overflow.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.absolute({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::abs({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.absv({0})`
  - Go: `Abs({0})`

#### `(min a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> N`
- **Description**: Lesser of two values in the sort order, so NaN is the greater.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.min_({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::min({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.min({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Min({0}, {1})`

#### `(max a b)`
- **Type**: `N N -> N`
- **Description**: Greater of two values in the sort order, so NaN is the greater.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.max_({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::max({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.max({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Max({0}, {1})`

### Comparison and logic

#### `(= a b)`
- **Type**: `T T -> Bool`
- **Description**: Structural equality.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.eq({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `({0} == {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.eq({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Eq({0}, {1})`

#### `(!= a b)`
- **Type**: `T T -> Bool`
- **Description**: Structural inequality.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `(not _agentscript.eq({0}, {1}))`
  - Rust: `({0} != {1})`
  - TypeScript: `(!RT.eq({0}, {1}))`
  - Go: `(!Eq({0}, {1}))`

#### `(< a b)`
- **Type**: `T T -> Bool`
- **Description**: Ordered comparison, for numbers and strings.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({0} < {1})`
  - Rust: `({0} < {1})`
  - TypeScript: `(RT.cmp({0}, {1}) < 0)`
  - Go: `({0} < {1})`

#### `(<= a b)`
- **Type**: `T T -> Bool`
- **Description**: Ordered comparison, for numbers and strings.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({0} <= {1})`
  - Rust: `({0} <= {1})`
  - TypeScript: `(RT.cmp({0}, {1}) <= 0)`
  - Go: `({0} <= {1})`

#### `(> a b)`
- **Type**: `T T -> Bool`
- **Description**: Ordered comparison, for numbers and strings.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({0} > {1})`
  - Rust: `({0} > {1})`
  - TypeScript: `(RT.cmp({0}, {1}) > 0)`
  - Go: `({0} > {1})`

#### `(>= a b)`
- **Type**: `T T -> Bool`
- **Description**: Ordered comparison, for numbers and strings.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({0} >= {1})`
  - Rust: `({0} >= {1})`
  - TypeScript: `(RT.cmp({0}, {1}) >= 0)`
  - Go: `({0} >= {1})`

#### `(and a b)`
- **Type**: `Bool Bool -> Bool`
- **Description**: Conjunction; short-circuits.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({0} and {1})`
  - Rust: `({0} && {1})`
  - TypeScript: `({0} && {1})`
  - Go: `({0} && {1})`

#### `(or a b)`
- **Type**: `Bool Bool -> Bool`
- **Description**: Disjunction; short-circuits.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({0} or {1})`
  - Rust: `({0} || {1})`
  - TypeScript: `({0} || {1})`
  - Go: `({0} || {1})`

#### `(not a)`
- **Type**: `Bool -> Bool`
- **Description**: Negation.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `(not {0})`
  - Rust: `(!{0})`
  - TypeScript: `(!{0})`
  - Go: `(!{0})`

### String

#### `(string-length a)`
- **Type**: `String -> Int64`
- **Description**: Length in characters.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `len({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::str_len(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.strLen({0})`
  - Go: `StrLen({0})`

#### `(string-empty? a)`
- **Type**: `String -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the string has no characters.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `(len({0}) == 0)`
  - Rust: `{0}.is_empty()`
  - TypeScript: `({0}.length === 0)`
  - Go: `({0} == "")`

#### `(str a b …)`
- **Type**: `String... -> String`
- **Description**: Concatenate strings. Takes strings only; convert first.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `"".join([{*}])`
  - Rust: `rt::concat(&[{*}])`
  - TypeScript: `RT.concat([{*}])`
  - Go: `Concat({*})`

#### `(string-slice a b c)`
- **Type**: `String Int64 Int64 -> (Option String)`
- **Description**: Half-open character slice, or none when out of range.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.str_slice({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Rust: `rt::str_slice(&{0}, {1}, {2})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.strSlice({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Go: `StrSlice({0}, {1}, {2})`

#### `(string-index-of a b)`
- **Type**: `String String -> (Option Int64)`
- **Description**: Character index of the first occurrence.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.str_index_of({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::str_index_of(&{0}, &{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.strIndexOf({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `StrIndexOf({0}, {1})`

#### `(string-contains? a b)`
- **Type**: `String String -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the substring occurs.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({1} in {0})`
  - Rust: `{0}.contains(&{1})`
  - TypeScript: `{0}.includes({1})`
  - Go: `StrContains({0}, {1})`

#### `(string-starts-with? a b)`
- **Type**: `String String -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the string begins with the prefix.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `{0}.startswith({1})`
  - Rust: `{0}.starts_with(&{1})`
  - TypeScript: `{0}.startsWith({1})`
  - Go: `StrStartsWith({0}, {1})`

#### `(string-ends-with? a b)`
- **Type**: `String String -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the string ends with the suffix.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `{0}.endswith({1})`
  - Rust: `{0}.ends_with(&{1})`
  - TypeScript: `{0}.endsWith({1})`
  - Go: `StrEndsWith({0}, {1})`

#### `(string-split a b)`
- **Type**: `String String -> (List String)`
- **Description**: Split on a separator.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `{0}.split({1})`
  - Rust: `rt::split(&{0}, &{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.split({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Split({0}, {1})`

#### `(string-join a b)`
- **Type**: `(List String) String -> String`
- **Description**: Join with a separator.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `{1}.join({0})`
  - Rust: `{0}.join(&{1})`
  - TypeScript: `{0}.join({1})`
  - Go: `StrJoin({0}, {1})`

#### `(string-upper a)`
- **Type**: `String -> String`
- **Description**: Upper case.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `{0}.upper()`
  - Rust: `{0}.to_uppercase()`

### List

#### `(list a b …)`
- **Type**: `T... -> (List T)`
- **Description**: Construct a list.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `[{*}]`
  - Rust: `vec![{*}]`
  - TypeScript: `[{*}]`
  - Go: `ListOf({*})`

#### `(list-empty? a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the list has no elements.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `(len({0}) == 0)`
  - Rust: `{0}.is_empty()`
  - TypeScript: `({0}.length === 0)`
  - Go: `(len({0}) == 0)`

#### `(list-length a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> Int64`
- **Description**: Element count.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `len({0})`
  - Rust: `({0}.len() as i64)`
  - TypeScript: `BigInt({0}.length)`
  - Go: `(int64(len({0})))`

#### `(list-get a b)`
- **Type**: `(List T) Int64 -> (Option T)`
- **Description**: Element at an index, or none.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.at({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::at(&{0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.at({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `At({0}, {1})`

#### `(list-head a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> (Option T)`
- **Description**: First element, or none.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.at({0}, 0)`
  - Rust: `rt::at(&{0}, 0)`
  - TypeScript: `RT.at({0}, 0n)`
  - Go: `At({0}, int64(0))`

#### `(list-tail a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> (Option (List T))`
- **Description**: All but the first element, or none when empty.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.tail({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::tail(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.tail({0})`
  - Go: `Tail({0})`

#### `(list-cons a b)`
- **Type**: `T (List T) -> (List T)`
- **Description**: Prepend an element.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `([{0}] + {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::cons({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `[{0}, ...{1}]`
  - Go: `Cons({0}, {1})`

#### `(list-append a b)`
- **Type**: `(List T) (List T) -> (List T)`
- **Description**: Concatenate two lists.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({0} + {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::append({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `[...{0}, ...{1}]`
  - Go: `Append({0}, {1})`

#### `(list-reverse a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> (List T)`
- **Description**: Reverse order.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `{0}[::-1]`
  - Rust: `rt::rev({0})`
  - TypeScript: `[...{0}].reverse()`
  - Go: `Rev({0})`

#### `(list-slice a b c)`
- **Type**: `(List T) Int64 Int64 -> (Option (List T))`
- **Description**: Half-open slice, or none when out of range.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.list_slice({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Rust: `rt::list_slice(&{0}, {1}, {2})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.listSlice({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Go: `ListSlice({0}, {1}, {2})`

#### `(list-contains? a b)`
- **Type**: `(List T) T -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the element occurs.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.contains({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `{0}.contains(&{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.contains({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Contains({0}, {1})`

#### `(list-index-of a b)`
- **Type**: `(List T) T -> (Option Int64)`
- **Description**: Index of the first occurrence.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.index_of({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::index_of(&{0}, &{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.indexOf({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `IndexOf({0}, {1})`

#### `(list-sort a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> (List T)`
- **Description**: Stable ascending sort; a value holding a NaN sorts last.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `sorted({0}, key=_agentscript.order_key)`
  - Rust: `rt::sort({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.sort({0})`
  - Go: `Sort({0})`

#### `(list-sort-by a b)`
- **Type**: `(fn [T] -> K) (List T) -> (List T)`
- **Description**: Stable ascending sort by a derived key; a key holding a NaN sorts last.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `sorted({1}, key=_agentscript.order_by({0}))`
  - Rust: `rt::sort_by({1}, {0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.sortBy({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `SortBy({0}, {1})`

#### `(map a b)`
- **Type**: `(fn [A] -> B) (List A) -> (List B)`
- **Description**: Apply a function to every element.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `[{0}(_x) for _x in {1}]`
  - Rust: `{1}.into_iter().map({0}).collect::<Vec<_>>()`
  - TypeScript: `{1}.map({0})`
  - Go: `Map({0}, {1})`

#### `(filter a b)`
- **Type**: `(fn [T] -> Bool) (List T) -> (List T)`
- **Description**: Keep elements satisfying a predicate.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `[_x for _x in {1} if {0}(_x)]`
  - Rust: `rt::filter({1}, {0})`
  - TypeScript: `{1}.filter({0})`
  - Go: `Filter({0}, {1})`

#### `(fold a b c)`
- **Type**: `(fn [B A] -> B) B (List A) -> B`
- **Description**: Left fold with an initial accumulator.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.fold({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Rust: `{2}.into_iter().fold({1}, {0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.fold({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Go: `Fold({0}, {1}, {2})`

#### `(range a b)`
- **Type**: `Int64 Int64 -> (List Int64)`
- **Description**: Half-open integer range; empty when start is not below end.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `list(range({0}, {1}))`
  - Rust: `rt::range({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.range({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Range({0}, {1})`

#### `(zip a b)`
- **Type**: `(List A) (List B) -> (List (Pair A B))`
- **Description**: Pair up elements, truncating to the shorter list.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.zip_({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::zip({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.zip({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `Zip({0}, {1})`

#### `(list-sum a)`
- **Type**: `(List N) -> N`
- **Description**: Sum of elements, 0 when empty. Traps on integer overflow.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.sum_({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::sum({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.sum({0})`
  - Go: `Sum({0})`

#### `(list-min a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> (Option T)`
- **Description**: Least element in the sort order, or none when empty.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.least({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::least(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.least({0})`
  - Go: `Least({0})`

#### `(list-max a)`
- **Type**: `(List T) -> (Option T)`
- **Description**: Greatest element in the sort order, or none when empty.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.greatest({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::greatest(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.greatest({0})`
  - Go: `Greatest({0})`

### Map

#### `(map-empty)`
- **Type**: `-> (Map K V)`
- **Description**: The empty map.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `{{}}`
  - Rust: `std::collections::BTreeMap::new()`
  - TypeScript: `RT.MAP_EMPTY`
  - Go: `MAP_EMPTY`

#### `(map-get a b)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) K -> (Option V)`
- **Description**: Value for a key, or none.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.m_get({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::m_get(&{0}, &{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mGet({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `MGet({0}, {1})`

#### `(map-set a b c)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) K V -> (Map K V)`
- **Description**: Map with the key bound to the value.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.m_set({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Rust: `rt::m_set({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mSet({0}, {1}, {2})`
  - Go: `MSet({0}, {1}, {2})`

#### `(map-remove a b)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) K -> (Map K V)`
- **Description**: Map without the key.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.m_del({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::m_del({0}, &{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mDel({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `MDel({0}, {1})`

#### `(map-has? a b)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) K -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the key is present.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `({1} in {0})`
  - Rust: `{0}.contains_key(&{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mHas({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `MHas({0}, {1})`

#### `(map-size a)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) -> Int64`
- **Description**: Number of entries.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `len({0})`
  - Rust: `({0}.len() as i64)`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mSize({0})`
  - Go: `(int64(len({0})))`

#### `(map-keys a)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) -> (List K)`
- **Description**: Keys, sorted.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `sorted({0}.keys())`
  - Rust: `{0}.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>()`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mKeys({0})`
  - Go: `MKeys({0})`

#### `(map-values a)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) -> (List V)`
- **Description**: Values, ordered by sorted key.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `[{0}[_k] for _k in sorted({0})]`
  - Rust: `{0}.values().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>()`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mValues({0})`
  - Go: `MValues({0})`

#### `(map-pairs a)`
- **Type**: `(Map K V) -> (List (Pair K V))`
- **Description**: Entries as pairs, ordered by sorted key.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.m_pairs({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::m_pairs(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mPairs({0})`
  - Go: `MPairs({0})`

#### `(map-from-pairs a)`
- **Type**: `(List (Pair K V)) -> (Map K V)`
- **Description**: Build from pairs; later entries win.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.m_from({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::m_from({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.mFrom({0})`
  - Go: `MFrom({0})`

### Option, Result, Pair

#### `(some a)`
- **Type**: `T -> (Option T)`
- **Description**: A present value.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.some({0})`
  - Rust: `Some({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.some({0})`
  - Go: `Some({0})`

#### `(none)`
- **Type**: `-> (Option T)`
- **Description**: An absent value.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.NONE`
  - Rust: `None`
  - TypeScript: `RT.NONE`
  - Go: `None[T]()`

#### `(ok a)`
- **Type**: `T -> (Result T E)`
- **Description**: A successful result.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.ok({0})`
  - Rust: `Ok({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.ok({0})`
  - Go: `Ok({0})`

#### `(err a)`
- **Type**: `E -> (Result T E)`
- **Description**: A failed result.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.err({0})`
  - Rust: `Err({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.err({0})`
  - Go: `Err({0})`

#### `(is-some? a)`
- **Type**: `(Option T) -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when a value is present.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.is_some({0})`
  - Rust: `{0}.is_some()`
  - TypeScript: `({0}.tag === "some")`
  - Go: `({0}.Present)`

#### `(is-none? a)`
- **Type**: `(Option T) -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when no value is present.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `(not _agentscript.is_some({0}))`
  - Rust: `{0}.is_none()`
  - TypeScript: `({0}.tag === "none")`
  - Go: `(!{0}.Present)`

#### `(is-ok? a)`
- **Type**: `(Result T E) -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the result succeeded.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.is_ok({0})`
  - Rust: `{0}.is_ok()`
  - TypeScript: `({0}.tag === "ok")`
  - Go: `({0}.IsOk)`

#### `(is-err? a)`
- **Type**: `(Result T E) -> Bool`
- **Description**: True when the result failed.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `(not _agentscript.is_ok({0}))`
  - Rust: `{0}.is_err()`
  - TypeScript: `({0}.tag === "err")`
  - Go: `(!{0}.IsOk)`

#### `(option-or a b)`
- **Type**: `(Option T) T -> T`
- **Description**: The value, or a fallback when absent.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.opt_or({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `{0}.unwrap_or({1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.optOr({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `OptOr({0}, {1})`

#### `(result-or a b)`
- **Type**: `(Result T E) T -> T`
- **Description**: The value, or a fallback on failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.res_or({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `{0}.unwrap_or({1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.resOr({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `ResOr({0}, {1})`

#### `(option-map a b)`
- **Type**: `(fn [A] -> B) (Option A) -> (Option B)`
- **Description**: Transform a present value.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.opt_map({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `{1}.map({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.optMap({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `OptMap({0}, {1})`

#### `(result-map a b)`
- **Type**: `(fn [A] -> B) (Result A E) -> (Result B E)`
- **Description**: Transform a successful value.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.res_map({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `{1}.map({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.resMap({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `ResMap({0}, {1})`

#### `(result-map-err a b)`
- **Type**: `(fn [E] -> F) (Result T E) -> (Result T F)`
- **Description**: Transform a failure value.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.res_map_err({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `{1}.map_err({0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.resMapErr({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `ResMapErr({0}, {1})`

#### `(option-to-result a b)`
- **Type**: `(Option T) E -> (Result T E)`
- **Description**: Absent becomes the given failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.opt_to_res({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `{0}.ok_or({1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.optToRes({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `OptToRes({0}, {1})`

#### `(result-to-option a)`
- **Type**: `(Result T E) -> (Option T)`
- **Description**: Failure becomes absence.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.res_to_opt({0})`
  - Rust: `{0}.ok()`
  - TypeScript: `RT.resToOpt({0})`
  - Go: `ResToOpt({0})`

#### `(pair a b)`
- **Type**: `A B -> (Pair A B)`
- **Description**: Construct a pair.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.pair({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `({0}, {1})`
  - TypeScript: `new RT.ASPair({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `MkPair({0}, {1})`

### I/O

#### `(not-found)`
- **Type**: `-> IoError`
- **Description**: The not found failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `("not-found",)`
  - Rust: `rt::IoError::NotFound`
  - TypeScript: `RT.notFound()`
  - Go: `NotFound()`

#### `(permission-denied)`
- **Type**: `-> IoError`
- **Description**: The permission denied failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `("permission-denied",)`
  - Rust: `rt::IoError::PermissionDenied`
  - TypeScript: `RT.permissionDenied()`
  - Go: `PermissionDenied()`

#### `(already-exists)`
- **Type**: `-> IoError`
- **Description**: The already exists failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `("already-exists",)`
  - Rust: `rt::IoError::AlreadyExists`
  - TypeScript: `RT.alreadyExists()`
  - Go: `AlreadyExists()`

#### `(invalid-path)`
- **Type**: `-> IoError`
- **Description**: The invalid path failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `("invalid-path",)`
  - Rust: `rt::IoError::InvalidPath`
  - TypeScript: `RT.invalidPath()`
  - Go: `InvalidPath()`

#### `(interrupted)`
- **Type**: `-> IoError`
- **Description**: The interrupted failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `("interrupted",)`
  - Rust: `rt::IoError::Interrupted`
  - TypeScript: `RT.interrupted()`
  - Go: `Interrupted()`

#### `(other)`
- **Type**: `-> IoError`
- **Description**: The other failure.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `("other",)`
  - Rust: `rt::IoError::Other`
  - TypeScript: `RT.other()`
  - Go: `Other()`

#### `(read-line)`
- **Type**: `-> (Result (Option String) IoError)`
- **Description**: Read one line from standard input; none at end of input.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.read_line()`
  - Rust: `rt::read_line()`
  - TypeScript: `RT.readLine()`
  - Go: `ReadLine()`

#### `(read-all)`
- **Type**: `-> (Result String IoError)`
- **Description**: Read all of standard input.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.read_all()`
  - Rust: `rt::read_all()`
  - TypeScript: `RT.readAll()`
  - Go: `ReadAll()`

#### `(print a)`
- **Type**: `String -> (Result Unit IoError)`
- **Description**: Write to standard output with no trailing newline.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.print_out({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::print_out(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.print_({0})`
  - Go: `PrintOut({0})`

#### `(println a)`
- **Type**: `String -> (Result Unit IoError)`
- **Description**: Write a line to standard output.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.println({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::println(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.println({0})`
  - Go: `Println({0})`

#### `(eprintln a)`
- **Type**: `String -> (Result Unit IoError)`
- **Description**: Write a line to standard error.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.eprintln({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::eprintln(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.eprintln({0})`
  - Go: `Eprintln({0})`

#### `(file-read a)`
- **Type**: `String -> (Result String IoError)`
- **Description**: Read a whole file as text.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.file_read({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::file_read(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.fileRead({0})`
  - Go: `FileRead({0})`

#### `(file-write a b)`
- **Type**: `String String -> (Result Unit IoError)`
- **Description**: Write text to a file, replacing it.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.file_write({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::file_write(&{0}, &{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.fileWrite({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `FileWrite({0}, {1})`

#### `(file-append a b)`
- **Type**: `String String -> (Result Unit IoError)`
- **Description**: Append text to a file, creating it if absent.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.file_append({0}, {1})`
  - Rust: `rt::file_append(&{0}, &{1})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.fileAppend({0}, {1})`
  - Go: `FileAppend({0}, {1})`

#### `(file-exists? a)`
- **Type**: `String -> (Result Bool IoError)`
- **Description**: Whether a path exists.
- **Runtime Lowering**:
  - Python: `_agentscript.file_exists({0})`
  - Rust: `rt::file_exists(&{0})`
  - TypeScript: `RT.ok(RT.fileExists({0}))`
  - Go: `FileExistsRes({0})`

## 8. CLI Toolchain & Model Context Protocol

- `asl run <file.asl>` — Evaluates script in native/Wasm isolate.
- `asl fmt <file.asl>` — Canonical AST formatter.
- `asl lint --fix <file.asl>` — Smell detector and structural AST auto-repair engine.
- `asl check <file.asl>` — Typechecker and semantic gate.
- `asl transcode <file.asl> --to nano|verbose` — Projection transcoder.
- `asl topo` — Module dependency DAG and circularity auditor.
- `asl mcp` — Model Context Protocol server exposing `asex_check`, `asex_eval`, `asex_format`, `asex_compress_module`.

Canonical Website: https://aslang.dev · Repository: https://github.com/GenSEAM/asl · MIT License
